title: Policy intake coalescer + sanity gate for region/tier/fallback routing
creator: Daniel Kim
description: Refactor the policy intake pipeline and introduce a coalescer/sanity gate that validates and normalizes routing DSL configs for region selection, tier-based routing, and fallback model variants. Goals: prevent runtime misroutes caused by ambiguous rules, provide developer-friendly lint errors & automated fix suggestions, and enable safe staged migrations for Dedicated/Private deployments. Deliverables: validator library (AST + semantic checks), dry-run linter CLI, autosuggest rewrites, audit-log hooks, and integration with Console lint UI.
acceptance_criteria: Validator library exposes stable API for parse->normalize->validate pipeline and has no breaking changes for existing consumers.
Linter CLI can process a policy bundle and return deterministic, human-actionable errors/warnings with suggested fixes.
Autosuggest module produces canonical rewrites for ambiguous region/tier predicates with a confidence score; suggestions are surfaced in Console as non-blocking warnings behind the feature flag.
Dry-run mode runs on staging shadow traffic for 72h without impacting live routing and reports any divergent route decisions to the dashboard.
Performance: lint throughput >= 100 policy bundles/second (95th percentile per-bundle latency < 250ms) in the validator service when benchmarked with representative corpus.
No production misroutes attributable to the new validator after 2 progressive canaries (observability: route mismatch rate, customer error rate, latency percentiles).
test_plan: Unit tests for AST transforms and semantic checks, property-based fuzzing against a corpus of sanitized production configs, integration tests for fallback resolution with model variant compatibility matrix, e2e dry-run in staging with 72h shadowing, and CI lint gating for policy PRs. Add monitoring dashboards for lint error counts and migration suggestion acceptance rate.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge behind feature flag. 2) Enable CI linting for all incoming policy PRs. 3) Turn on dry-run validation in staging and run 72h shadow traffic. 4) Enable enforcement for 5% of customers and monitor route-match divergence & errors for 7 days. 5) Increase to 25% then 100% after success. Provide rollback on increased misroute rate > 0.05%.
